name: California Interagency Council on Homelessness
description: The California Interagency Council on Homelessness (Cal ICH) is the State of California's central coordinating body charged with aligning homelessness policy, data, and programs across state government. Established in statute, Cal ICH brings together 19 state agencies and departments to prevent and end homelessness.

children.name: California Interagency Council on Homelessness
children.description:
1740 - CALIFORNIA INTERAGENCY COUNCIL ON HOMELESSNESS

Cal ICH provides statewide leadership, data-driven accountability, and hands-on support to strengthen California's homelessness response. Through the Homeless Data Integration System (HDIS)—the state's first longitudinal dataset integrating information from every Continuum of Care (CoC)—Cal ICH equips local and state partners with timely, actionable data that guide policy, improve outcomes, and increase transparency. Cal ICH leads the implementation of California's 3-Year Statewide Action Plan to End and Prevent Homelessness, aligning state investments and local efforts around clear goals. Cal ICH delivers direct technical assistance to cities, counties, and CoCs to support performance improvement, program design, data quality, encampment resolution, and alignment with Housing First principles and state requirements. Together, these efforts advance a coordinated, accountable, and outcomes-focused statewide system capable of driving lasting reductions in homelessness.
